Hi Lisa Rozumniak! No, I only went to MOT to get the fake Israeli id number, then I did the eye test. Then I took my last two licenses totalling 5 years of driving experience to misrad harishui, and then they converted it to an Israeli license without needing to do any tests.
If you have 5 years or more experience, you should be able to just convert it without taking tests is my understanding and personal experience
